verdict.rationale: SES supports multiple verified domain identities, IAM-based access control, configuration sets for tagging and segmenting mail, and leased dedicated IPs that give control over sender reputation. Together these are building blocks for tenant separation, but the pack shows no native subaccount or tenant construct, so the platform engineer must assemble isolation from these pieces. Missing for 10: a native subaccount/tenant feature, per-tenant suppression lists, per-tenant reputation tracking and enforcement, documented per-tenant credential scoping, and independent corroboration of a multi-tenant setup.
